newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-LORD GYLLENE TRIUMPHS IN RESCHEDULED GRAND NATIONAL.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-LORD GYLLENE TRIUMPHS IN RESCHEDULED GRAND NATIONAL.

text.p: Lord Gyllene, ridden by Tony Dobbin and trained by Steve Brookshaw, won the rescheduled Grand National steeplechase at Aintree on Monday.
Lord Gyllene (14-1) made all the running and won easily from Suny Bay (8-1), the mount of Jamie Osborne. Camelot Knight, a 100-1 outsider ridden by Carl Llewellyn, ran on to be third.
The National took place amid the tightest security ever seen at a British racecourse after a bomb scare forced the race to be called off on Saturday.
Prime Minister John Major, breaking into his election schedule, and Princess Anne, daughter of Britain's Queen Elizabeth, attended Monday's running.
